It is located in southwest County Mayo on the Murrisk peninsula.


== Geography ==
Doo Lough measures about 4 km (2.5 mi) long and 1 km (0.6 mi) wide. It lies about 30 km (19 mi) southwest of Westport near the village of Delphi.  The lake runs in a narrow northwest to southeast direction, and is overlooked by the long ridge of Ben Lugmore 803-metre (2,635 ft), on its southwest shores, and by Barrclashcame 772-metre (2,533 ft) on its northeast shores.  At its southeast head, lies the massif of Ben Gorm 700-metre (2,297 ft).
